description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Petroleum Production Engineering topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: petroleum-production

facts.claim: In cased holes, perforations let oil flow from rock into the well

source.quote: small perforations are made in the portion of the casing across the production zone, to provide a path for the oil to flow

facts.claim: Perforating guns with shaped charges punch holes through the casing

source.quote: running in perforating guns, a string of shaped charges

facts.claim: Needed when reservoir pressure cannot lift fluids to the surface

source.quote: Artificial lift is needed in wells when there is insufficient pressure in the reservoir to lift the produced fluids to the surface

facts.claim: A beam pumpjack turns rotary motion into reciprocating rod motion

source.quote: converts the rotary motion of the motor (usually electric) to the vertical reciprocating motion

facts.claim: Injected gas lightens the fluid column so reservoir pressure can lift it

source.quote: Injected gas aerates the fluid to reduce its density

facts.claim: The Christmas tree's valves and chokes control flow from the well

source.quote: The surface pressure control is provided by a Christmas tree, which is installed on top of the wellhead

facts.claim: Separators split well fluids into oil, gas and water

source.quote: to separate production fluids into their constituent components of oil, gas and water

facts.claim: Prevent hydrates, wax, asphaltenes and scale from blocking flow

source.quote: flow assurance involves effectively handling many solid deposits, such as, gas hydrates, asphaltene, wax, scale

facts.claim: Hydraulic fracturing: high-pressure fluid fractures rock; proppants hold fractures open

source.quote: small grains of hydraulic fracturing proppants (either sand or aluminium oxide) hold the fractures open
Typically, the gas is a mix of gaseous hydrocarbons, primarily methane (95%)

facts.claim: Production starts by drilling wells into the reservoir

source.quote: Extracting crude oil normally starts with drilling wells into an underground reservoir

facts.claim: Horizontal wells are drilled by directional (non-vertical) drilling

source.quote: Directional drilling (or slant drilling) is the practice of drilling non-vertical bores
